kids: Watch dozens of floats roll down Main Street
See local school groups and entertainers
site: Route ends at Alachua Farm and Lumber
about: Parade entrants check in at Lee's Preschool at 9 AM to get a spot number, which is painted on the road on the south side of Main Street.
The parade crosses over US 441 onto the north side of Main Street and continues all the way down to Alachua Farm and Lumber, so spectators can choose where along that stretch to stand.
The chamber runs the parade in partnership with the City of Alachua, and a participation link goes up on the chamber page in early November.
The chamber says the parade gives businesses a chance to reach thousands of attendees along Main Street.
The city's Christmas on Main tree lighting is a separate evening event a week earlier.
faq: When is the Alachua Christmas Parade?
Saturday, December 12, 2026, starting at 11 AM sharp.
Where does the parade run?
Along historic Main Street, crossing US 441 and ending near Alachua Farm and Lumber.
Who hosts it?
The Alachua Chamber of Commerce, in partnership with the City of Alachua.
What is in the parade?
Dozens of floats, entertainers and local school organizations.
How do groups enter?
Through the sign up link on the chamber's parade page, then check in at Lee's Preschool at 9 AM.
Does it cost anything to watch?
The public can watch from the street at no charge.

kids: Watch the town tree light up at the pavilion
See floats pass along Main Street at twilight
Make a two Saturday holiday plan
site: Farmers Market Pavilion for the tree lighting
about: The chamber's events page labels the first entry Tree Lighting (Pavilion) on December 5, 2026, and the second the 28th Annual Twilight Christmas Parade on December 12.
A Gainesville area calendar lists the tree lighting at the Farmers Market Pavilion at 23517 NW 185 Rd with free admission and no other date in the following 90 days.
The parade has run for 28 years, and the chamber office collects applications from groups that want to be in the line up.
A separate Facebook event shows the parade on Main Street in High Springs with a 6 PM start.
The chamber office can be reached at 386-454-3120, with a cell number of 704-579-1295, or by email at decker@highspringscoc.com.
The same events page also hosts the chamber's Fall Festival vendor application, which is a separate autumn event.
faq: When is the High Springs tree lighting?
Saturday, December 5, 2026, at 5 PM at the Farmers Market Pavilion.
When is the High Springs Christmas Parade?
Saturday, December 12, 2026, at 6 PM on Main Street.
Which parade number is this?
The 28th annual Twilight Christmas Parade.
Who organizes both events?
The High Springs Chamber of Commerce.
Does it cost anything to attend?
Local listings show the tree lighting as free, and the parade is a public street event.
How do I ask about entering a float?
Call the chamber at 386-454-3120 or email decker@highspringscoc.com.

kids: Watch a free holiday movie on the Herlong Mansion lawn
Hear a holiday story reading before the tree lighting
site: Holiday market and extended shopping hours
about: The Town of Micanopy published its Light Up Micanopy news release on November 16, 2026, and links a flyer with the full schedule.
Saturday's lineup includes student performances and a free outdoor holiday movie on the lawn at Herlong Mansion.
Sunday begins with a concert at the Church of the Mediator, then moves to the Town Hall tree lighting ceremony.
A holiday story reading and a performance by the Willie Mae Stokes After School Program follow the lighting.
Live music runs through the weekend, and Visit Gainesville lists the address as 202 NE 7 Ave in Micanopy 32667.
In 2025 the town ran a one day Holiday Stroll with Santa and a 5 PM tree lighting, and the 2026 version grows into two days.
faq: When is Light Up Micanopy?
Saturday and Sunday, December 12 and 13, 2026.
What time does it run?
Visit Gainesville lists 10 AM Saturday through 6 PM Sunday, and the town flyer has the detailed schedule.
Is there a movie?
Yes, a free outdoor holiday movie plays on the lawn at Herlong Mansion on Saturday.
When is the tree lighting?
On Sunday at the Town Hall.
Can kids see Santa?
Visits with Santa and Mrs. Claus are part of the weekend.
Where is it?
In historic downtown Micanopy.
